To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a 3D collagen I culture system that does permit specification of all lung lineages and is permissive of terminal maturation of lung cells from hPSc-derived lung progenitors.
we describe a collagen I 3-D culture system that is permissive for multilineage specification of lung and airways, and that GSK3 inhibition inhibits terminal maturation.

1) a collagen I 3d culture system that does NOT rely on reporter lines is permissive for specification of all lung lineages, 2) inhibition of GSK3 promotes cell cycling but prevents maturation of lung cells, and 3) WNT and NOTCH signaling pathways play a role in proximodistsal specification of lung cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and use of a novel 3D model of human lung development.
the generation of functional airway epithelium from human pluripotent cells.
the differentiation and development of human lung and airways from pluripotent stem (hPSC) cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this is an excellent study that will provide a useful platform for the development of lung cells from hPSc.
the collagen I 3-D culture system does not require the use of reporter lines, and that the system is permissive for specification of all lung/airway lineages.
the collagen 3D culture model is an important step in the maturation process of hPSCs into mature lung epithelial cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

GSK3 inhibition is required to prevent the maturation of hPSC-derived LPs, that cell cycle inhibition is sufficient to promote maturation of these cells, and that NOTCH and WNT signaling play distinct roles in proximodistance specification in the lung.
we have developed an efficient method for the differentiation of hPSCs into lung and airways in 3D cultures that is permissive for terminal differentiation of all lung and proximal airway lineages.

we developed a 3D culture model that is permissive for multilineage maturation from human pluripotent progenitors and used this model to investigate the role of GSK-3 inhibition on lung progenitor maturation, as well as the role of NOTCH and WNT signaling on proximodistalspecification in human lung development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
GSK3 is a critical inhibitor of lung maturation and that its inhibition results in the generation of immature cells.
GSK3 inhibition is a key factor in the terminal maturation of lung cells.
glycogen synthase 3 kinase is required for the maturation of human lung progenitors.
